water.label: Water
water.desc: The bruiser. You decide where everyone stands: every skill shoves or drags, what is shoved into something is Crushed, and every Crush shores you up with Ward.
water.rule: Water moves bodies: its skills shove and drag, and a shoved body that meets a wall, stone or another body is Crushed; every Crush you cause shores you up with a 15 Ward (up to 60, for 6 s).

fire.label: Fire
fire.desc: You get hotter, and so does everything near you. Your own heat is your damage - right up to the moment it locks.
fire.rule: Fire runs on its own heat: fire reflux is a damage multiplier, and fire skills build it, scale with it, or spend it.
fire.role: Burst caster - big hits, spreading burns

earth.label: Earth
earth.desc: The area tank. Slow, heavy and sure: you raise stone, stand Braced, break poise and call the enemy onto you.
earth.rule: Earth holds its ground: its skills raise, use or break your stone, wind up Braced, break poise, and call the enemy onto you.

wind.label: Wind
wind.desc: The evasive monk. You are only dangerous while you are moving: run and the pips fill, stand to think and they drain; turn blows aside and strike the back.
wind.rule: Wind is paid for by moving: running earns Slipstream pips, every wind skill spends (or earns) pips for its real effect, and wind hits from behind do half again (Lee).
wind.role: Evasive monk - positioning, rear hits, speed

lightning.label: Lightning
lightning.desc: The spellblade (Fire's burst, Wind's speed). One target, three touches, gone; every Overload leaves you Quickened. Its heat does not bleed off in a fight.
lightning.rule: Lightning marks a target and overloads it: every lightning hit leaves Live marks, and the third mark is an Overload - a burst that stuns the target and arcs to every other marked enemy within 12 m - that leaves you Quickened for 1.5 s.

ice.label: Ice
ice.desc: Control (Water's flow, Dark's stillness). Cold stays: lay Chill until they lock solid, then break them with one hard hit. Wet things freeze faster.
ice.rule: Cold stays: every ice hit adds Chill, which never wears off by itself (Dark's stillness); at 5 Chill the target freezes solid, and a frozen thing is Brittle, so the next hard hit Shatters it. Wet freezes fast (Water's flow): an ice hit on a Soaked target adds one more Chill and ends the Soak.

dark.label: Dark
dark.desc: Strongest where the light is weakest. Make your own dark, stand in it unseen, and hit them while they stand in it.
dark.rule: Dark is strongest where the light is weakest: every spot is Lit, Dim or Dark; dark hits do +25% to a target standing in Dark and -20% in Lit; you are Unseen while you stand in Dark, and your first hit out of Unseen is an Ambush - it counts as from behind and does +50%.

metal.label: Metal
metal.desc: The armoured duellist (Earth's ground, Fire's forge). Armour is your target; every metal blow on the same enemy heats your edge.
metal.rule: Metal is worn and wielded: its hits ignore front armour and do +25% per metal class the target wears, and every metal blow on the same enemy heats your edge (Edge Heat, up to 5, +8% each); strike another, or go 3 s without a metal blow, and it cools.

blood.label: Blood
blood.desc: The berserker (Life and Death spilled). Open Bleeding, drink the pools, hold the blood: every measure you hold makes your blows harder. Never your own health.
blood.rule: Blood works blood that is already out: its hits open Bleeding, bleeders spill pools, and you hold what you drink (up to 10 measures); every measure you hold makes your blows 2% harder (Bloodrush), and blood skills spend Bleeding, pools or held blood - never your health. Blood never heals.
blood.role: Berserker - spilled life, never your own

life.label: Life
life.desc: The healer. Inside living bodies: past armour and shields, hardest on the hale, nothing to the unliving. It mends you and your living summons, faster just after you land a hit.
life.rule: Life works inside living bodies: its harm passes armour and hits the hale (above half health) 25% harder, it does nothing to the unliving, and it heals over time - you and your living summons, the bar fast and wounds slowly - half as fast again for 2 s after each hit you land.

death.label: Death
death.desc: The necromancer. What has died stays useful: corpses lie longer for you, up to three of your dead fight for you, and the Dying take more.
death.rule: What has died stays useful: every enemy corpse lies 20 s for you and Death skills spend it, up to three of your dead fight for you as thralls, and a living target below half health is Dying and takes 30% more from Death.

nature.label: Nature
nature.desc: The druid (Earth's ground, Life's growth). Plant growth that stays, spreads and ages; stand in it to regrow, call beasts up out of it, then cash it in.
nature.rule: Nature's growth stays in the ground and ages (sprout, grown, bloom), spreading on open ground; you and your beasts standing in your growth are In the Green - regrowing 1.5 health a second and hard to move - and any patch can be called up as a beast.

light.label: Light
light.desc: The ranged caster. Light arrives at once along a straight line; whatever it touches is Lit, and a light hit on a Lit target Sears it.
light.rule: Light arrives at once along a dead straight line and stops on the first opaque thing; whatever it touches is Lit (shown through any cover, front armour counts half), and a light hit on a target that is already Lit Sears it: +25%, and the Lit starts again.

dream.label: Dream
dream.desc: Takes hold only of a mind that can see you, or one asleep. Past armour and shields, harder on the Dazed and the Asleep.
dream.rule: A Dream skill takes hold only of a mind that can see it (Light's half: you, or the thing you made, in its front arc with a clear line) or that is asleep (Dark's half); it ignores armour and shields, does +30% to the Dazed and the Asleep, its statuses last half again as long on them and a quarter longer on a target standing in Dim light - the twilight. Mindless things never feel it.

poison.label: Poison
poison.desc: Coating (Water's taint, Death deferred). A coat puts its payload on every weapon hit and shot; the first dose starts a 6 s clock, the rest add to the bill, and the clock pays it all at once.
poison.rule: Poison rides your weapon: a coat puts its payload on every weapon hit and ranged shot for a time, the first dose in a body starts a 6 s clock that later doses add to but never reset, and when it runs out every dose is paid at once (20 each). It never spreads on its own.
poison.role: Coating - tainted water that pays out later

disease.label: Disease
disease.desc: Plague (Earth's rot, Death's feeding). It lives in flesh and clouds: a carrier passes it to anyone who stays beside it. Armour cuts it, shields and facing do not.
disease.rule: Disease spreads through flesh: Infected ticks (times flesh, so armour cuts it and stone and constructs ignore it), passes a stack to any enemy that stays within 1.5 m of a carrier for 1 s, and rises as clouds from the ground and from the bodies it kills.

holy.label: Holy
holy.desc: The paladin (Light and Life). Wards take blows before your bar, and a ward that breaks pays out its light; it covers you and your summons, and its healing touches only the living.
holy.rule: Holy wards what is yours: a ward takes blows before your bar, so a blow it wholly stops opens no wound, and when a ward breaks it pays out its light - 30 and Lit to every enemy within 3 m. Wards cover you and your summons, living or not; Holy's healing touches only the living.

unholy.label: Unholy
unholy.desc: The shadow knight (Dark and Death). Every hit drains part of the harm back to you as health, twice that from the Dying or from anything in the Dark, and banks it as stolen life for your skills.
unholy.rule: Unholy feeds on what it hurts: every Unholy hit drains 10% of the damage it deals to the living back to you as health, twice that from the Dying or from anything standing in Dark, and what it drains is also banked as stolen life for your skills to spend.
